# FG-CI-0008

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | [`ci-runner`](../../ops/runbooks/ci-runner.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_definition_hash_mismatch_fails_the_job_before_any_container` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: CI のジョブの定義がパイプラインを作ったときのものと一致しません。ジョブは実行されませんでした。
- en: The CI job's definition does not match the one the pipeline was planned from. The job was not run.
- id: Definisi tugas CI tidak cocok dengan definisi saat pipeline direncanakan. Tugas tidak dijalankan.

## 原因 (cause)

M4 C4 (plan 14 C3 note, ADR-0029): the server keeps no job script; `forge-runner` reads `.forge-ci.yml` at the job's pinned commit and runs it only when its sha256 equals the claimed job's `definition_hash` (the bytes the pipeline was planned from), the file parses, and it still has the job with the claimed image and timeout. Any difference — the file is missing, its bytes changed (a corrupted repository, a forged pipeline row, a server bug), the job or its image is not in it, or the claim had no hash — fails the job before any container starts.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The runner host (`journalctl -u forge-runner`, JSON) logs the failure once (warn) with `error_code`, `request_id` and in `context` `job_id`, `attempt`, `pipeline_id`, `project_id`, `reason` (`claim_invalid` / `hash_mismatch` / `no_hash` / `definition_missing` / `definition_invalid` / `job_missing` / `image_mismatch` / `timeout_mismatch`) and, for a hash mismatch, `expected` and `actual`; the job's log ends with the same code. Compare with SELECT definition_hash, sha FROM forge.ci_pipelines WHERE id = <pipeline_id>; and `git cat-file blob <sha>:.forge-ci.yml | sha256sum` in the repository.

## 対処 (fix)

Follow runbook ci-runner: a mismatch on a healthy repository is a defect (report it with the request id); a damaged repository is restored from backup. Push a new commit (or run the pipeline again) to plan a fresh pipeline.
